The '''silver sword''' is an [[Iron equipment|iron sword]] inlaid with silver and fitted with a [[Nazar]]. It combines [[Smite]] III with {{G|Warding}} 1, making it a weapon built against the undead.

== Obtaining ==
=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Silver Bullion]] serves as the smithing template. Silver is found mainly in mountains and [[Abbey]]s. Enchantments already on the iron sword are kept; where the old sword and the silver sword share an enchantment, the higher level is used (see [[Set bonus#Intrinsic enchantments|intrinsic enchantments]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/select_higher_level.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Weapon ===
The silver sword deals {{Value|Silver Sword|damage}} of damage with an attack speed of {{Value|Silver Sword|attackspeed}} and has {{Value|Silver Sword|durability}} durability, one more point of damage than the [[Warding Sword]] but less durability. Its [[Smite]] III adds damage against undead mobs.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/silver_sword.json}}</ref>

=== Warding ===
Held in either hand, the sword gives {{G|Warding}} 1, the same as the warding sword, and stacks with warding in the other hand up to {{G|Warding}} 3. See [[Warding]].

=== Repairing ===
The silver sword can only be repaired with a [[Nazar]] or a {{MCW|Block of Lapis Lazuli|block of lapis lazuli}}.

== Advancements ==
Smithing the silver sword grants ''Sabbatarian'' ("Affix a Nazar to an Iron Sword inlaid with Silver in a Smithing Table") in the [[Advancements/Tutorial|Tutorial]] tab, which rewards an [[Obol]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/smith_silver_sword.json}}</ref> Collecting silver grants ''The Warding Metal'': "Silver, a once-common Apotropaic Metal is found most commonly in Mountains. Most deposits are now harboured in Abbeys."
